title: iscell
summary: Return true when a value is a cell array.

gpu_support.notes: Metadata-only predicate; gpuArray inputs return false.

description: `iscell(A)` returns a logical scalar indicating whether `A` is represented as a MATLAB cell array.
behaviors: Cell arrays, including empty cells, return true.
Numeric, logical, string, character, struct, object, function handle, and gpuArray values return false.

faqs.question: Does `iscell` inspect cell contents?
faqs.answer: No. It only checks the container type.

gpu_residency: The result is a host logical scalar.
